rows.grounds: bahuvrīhi compound: tri-tattva-ācamana-prītā; describes the goddess as delighted by the ritual sipping of the three principles (tattva)
compound: tri-tattva-ācamana-iṣṭa-dā; describes the goddess as granting the desired fruit of the three-principle sipping

items.question: What delight and desired boon arise from the ritual sipping of the three principles?
premises: The goddess is pleased by the ritual sipping of the three principles.
The goddess grants the desired fruit of the three-principle sipping.
The three-principle sipping thus connects divine pleasure with the fulfillment of desire.
items.inference: Therefore, the ritual sipping of the three principles both pleases the goddess and secures its desired boon.
uncertainties: The specific referents of the three tattva (principles/elements) are not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: She is pleased by the sipping of the three principles and grants the desired fruit of that three-principle sipping.
